events.verdict: Brogdon (IND) veers into Allen's (NYK) path at the end of his drive, but the contact is marginal.
Holiday (IND) places his forearm to the front of Morris Sr. (NYK) during the screen, but does not affect his FOM off ball.
Sabonis (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Bullock (NYK) and slightly extends his arm, but does not dislodge Bullock during the pick.
Oladipo (IND) briefly grasps Portis' (NYK) jersey during the screen.
Morris Sr. (NYK) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Sabonis (IND) that affects his ability to land after the release of his driving shot attempt.
Portis (NYK) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Holiday (IND) and absorbs the contact.
Allen (NYK) slightly extends his arm into Sabonis (IND), but does not dislodge him during the screen.
Sabonis (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Allen (NYK) and absorbs the contact.
Brogdon (IND) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Morris Sr. (NYK) and absorbs the contact.
Allen (NYK) makes some contact to Brogdon's (IND) arm, but does not affect his control of the ball.
Sabonis (IND) dislodges Morris Sr. (NYK) along the baseline.
Holiday (IND) commits a take foul on Morris Sr. (NYK).
